SECTION 2

Second Section

If the header is repeating here, the sticky-hide mechanism is broken.

Specifically, this test page sets visibility: visible on child elements of the header (nav links), which overrides visibility: hidden on the parent. The fix is to use opacity: 0 instead, which operates at the compositing layer and cannot be overridden by children.
